messages.subject: ggbarplots and dateRangeInput
parts:
I have been building a shiny app for a while and have been making barplots using ggplot to display the data. i am plotting attendance data and on the xaxis i am showing date and on the y i am showing headcount. i have three years of data and want the user to be able to display barplot graphs filtered according to the date using the drop down calenders. I have been searching tirelessly for an example that does this and not had any luck. i have a column in my data set with dates and a column with headcount from the dataset finalartdata

my ggplots look like this:

  if(input$parameters == "Type3")
    {
      
      qq <- ggplot(finalartdata[354:505,], aes(x=Date, y=Head.Count)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge", fill="lightblue", colour="black") +
        geom_text(aes(label=Head.Count), vjust=1.5, colour="white",
                  position=position_dodge(.9), size=3)
      print(qq) 
    } 

the Date variable that i am currently using to make the plots looks like this

variables <- reactive({
              Date <- finalartdata[finalartdata$Date == datasetInput, ]
              Head.Count <- finalartdata[finalartdata$Head.Count == datasetInput, ]
})

i have been getting my data using this

datasetInput <- reactive({
    switch(input$parameters,
           "Type3" = finalartdata[354:505,],
           "Type1" = finalartdata[296:353,],
           "Type4" = finalartdata[506:639,],
           "Type5" = finalartdata[242:295,],
           "Type6" = finalartdata[640:777,],
           "Type7" = finalartdata[778:853,],
           "Type8" = finalartdata[854:859,]
  )})

and my ui.r looks like this

 dateRangeInput("date", "choose a date range", start = "2011-01-01", end = "2014-7-30", format = "yyyy-mm-dd"),
      
      selectInput("parameters",
                             label="choose a type", list("Other" = "Type1", "University classes" = "Type", "Meeting (M) (Museum Related)" = "Type3", "Non Museum Meeting (NM)" = "Type4", "Museum Programs (MP)" = "Type5", "Non Museum related programs (NMP)" = "Type6", "Student Meeting/Event (Museum Related)" = "Type7", "Non Museum Student Meeting/Event (NMS)" = "Type8", "School Groups (SG)" = "Type9", "Tours" = "Type10", "Art Explorers (AE)" = "Type11", "McGuffey" = "Type12", "Reception" = "Type13"), selected=NULL)
 

i just cant figure out how to set up my server to make it so its plotting the dates on the x-axis based off what is being selected in the dateRangeInput. Thanks for any help on this matter
